title: Package Inclusions Composer
outcome: Approved operator members can manage truthful package Included and Not included terms in one NoorPath composer, move items between the two lists by drag or keyboard-accessible controls, and add package-specific items with curated NoorPath icon choices while the existing ordered string authoring contract remains authoritative.
actor: Approved operator members authoring a private package and departure draft.
modules: Web owns the package-inclusion composer interaction, icon presentation, responsive behavior and accessible drag alternatives.
Catalogue remains authoritative for the ordered inclusion and exclusion strings persisted on the draft package version.
Existing VS-02 operator authorization, tenant isolation, validation, audit and create/update API contracts remain unchanged.
Curated icon choices are presentation metadata for authoring and do not create a new persisted catalogue field in this slice.
routes: Operator workspace -> Packages -> Create package -> Package inclusions & exclusions
Included item -> drag or Move to Not included -> Not included list
Not included item -> drag or Move to Included -> Included list
Suggested item -> Include or Exclude -> selected list
Add custom item -> choose NoorPath icon -> Included or Not included
Create package -> existing draft creation contract -> departure editor
Package authoring -> shared operator navigation -> Packages
acceptance: Package authoring presents explicit Included and Not included lists using the existing NoorPath visual language and one consistent SVG icon family.
An item can be moved between Included and Not included by native drag-and-drop without being duplicated across both lists.
Every drag move has a visible keyboard- and touch-operable Move control that performs the same state change without requiring pointer precision.
The existing standard package inclusions and exclusions remain operator-editable defaults; market research is advisory only and does not turn third-party promises into NoorPath policy.
Variable travel-kit, Umrah-kit, baggage, room-service, laundry, SIM, Zamzam and insurance facts remain explicit suggestions or operator choices rather than silently guaranteed inclusions.
Add custom item offers curated icon choices from the existing NoorPath line-icon family and adds the item to the operator-selected destination list.
Draft submission continues to persist ordered inclusion and exclusion strings through the existing VS-02 create contract without a schema or API compatibility change.
Existing operator authorization, tenant isolation, validation and draft audit behavior remain unchanged.
Changed controls preserve visible focus, at least 44px actionable targets, reduced-motion behavior, mobile reflow and no horizontal overflow at 390px.
Rendered and navigation evidence belongs to the exact unchanged implementation SHA.
exclusions: Persisting icon metadata as a new Catalogue field or changing public package API contracts.
Importing scraped competitor package terms, prices, visa rules, taxes, refunds or guarantees as NoorPath commercial policy.
Changing package publication, pricing, inventory, booking or payment rules.
Changing operator permissions or tenant isolation.
Adding a drag-and-drop or icon dependency when native browser behavior and the existing icon family are sufficient.
Redesigning the shared operator shell or customer package presentation.
